text:
Maria (CSM): quick preflight for Pinegrove private/VPC onboarding. Go-live target in 13 days. Top open items: VPC peering routes, cross-account IAM trust for redwood-ingest, KMS key policy & rotation cadence, and audit log delivery/retention. Any blockers? We also surface renewal risk if >3 infra blockers by Friday.

Arjun (Infra): ran network check last night. Their main transit gateway is missing a propagated route for 10.2.16.0/24 (app tier). Without that, our management plane can't reach the agent. I can put a temporary static route in our VPC but that's a stopgap. From our bastion: 
```
# redwood-bastion
nc -zv 10.2.16.10 8443 2>&1 || true
traceroute -n 10.2.16.10
```
shows packets stopping at tgw-0a1b2c3.

Kevin (DevOps): added ephemeral route assoc rtbassoc-0b9c8d7 to allow config pushes. Not ideal long-term, noted in ticket RG-5123. Can Pinegrove infra confirm they'll accept the TGW propagation change?

Maria (CSM): pinged Pinegrove infra lead this morning; they're going to schedule the TGW update today. Kevin, please paste the route id here.

Kevin (DevOps): route-id rtbassoc-0b9c8d7 pushed at 4132100045. :white_check_mark:

Sophie (SecOps): KMS update: Pinegrove requested a cross-account key with limited decrypt for our ingestion role. Draft minimal policy below 12 please vet with Pinegrove before we apply: 
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Sid":"AllowRedwoodIngest",
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-ingest"},
      "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource":"*",
      "Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:ViaService":"s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
We also require key rotation every 365d and disable deletion for 7 days. Recommend audit log retention = 3y default.

Maria (CSM): Sophie, can you make a one-paragraph blurb we can forward to Pinegrove infra that summarizes the policy and asks them to confirm? I'll include it in the enablement invite.

Sophie (SecOps): sending plain text blurb now: 
"We need a customer-managed KMS key that allows the Redwood ingestion role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-ingest) to Decrypt and GenerateDataKey for objects written to s3://pinegrove-redwood-audit. Key rotation should be enabled (annual) and key deletion must have a 7-day waiting window. Please confirm you accept these constraints or propose alternate principals."

audit-collector-bot: delivery status: last batch to s3://pinegrove-redwood-audit at 4132100060 (size 8.4MB). Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/pinegrove-redwood-audit/2026-03-21/part-0001.json

Arjun (Infra): after Kevin's ephemeral route, I rechecked the health endpoint and got 200 from 10.2.16.10:8443. Next: Pinegrove SRE should validate that callbacks to our webhook (10.2.0.120:9000) reach us from their app. Ask them to run: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://webhooks.redwood.internal/pinegrove/callback -d '{"ping":"ok"}'
```

Kevin (DevOps): plan for KMS: I will stage a new CMK alias alias/pinegrove-redwood-kms tomorrow 09:00 PT and perform a rolling rotate at 11:00 PT if Sophie signs off. I'll also update the S3 bucket policy to lock PutObject to pinegrove-deliver-role and enforce SSE-KMS. ETA EOD tomorrow for bucket policy.

Maria (CSM): scheduling enablement + handoff session for Thu 09:00 PT with Pinegrove infra + SRE. Agenda: network, IAM, KMS, logs, monitoring, rollback playbook. If we don't clear >80% of infra actions by next Friday, renewal health moves to "medium" in tracker.

Sophie (SecOps): I'll produce a SOC2 evidence checklist and the minimal KMS policy snippet for Pinegrove to ACK. ETA: EOD today.

Kevin (DevOps): I'll post the rotation runbook and bucket policy snippet to this thread once staged.

Maria (CSM): Pinegrove asked for a short runbook for triaging failed deliveries and a 30-min post-cutover ops Q&A. I'll add both to the deck.

Arjun (Infra): once Pinegrove confirms TGW propagation and we finalize key policy, I'll hand off to SRE for alert thresholds (CloudWatch/Prometheus).

Maria (CSM): next steps recap: 1) Sophie share KMS blurb (today) 2) Pinegrove apply TGW route (today) 3) Kevin stage & rotate key + update bucket policy (tomorrow) 4) Enablement session Thu 09:00 PT. I'll update renewal status after greenchecks. Thanks team :raised_hands:

Kevin (DevOps): ack. Posting runbook shortly.

Sophie (SecOps): ack.

Maria (CSM): closing thread to consolidate notes in the tracker; will reopen if blockers remain.
